title: Atlas · 项目归档规范 / Archive policy
text: Atlas 项目完成验收后进入归档。负责人先核验 Jira 工单已关闭，再把 Confluence 页面设为只读。Slack 频道保留历史记录，并在频道名添加 archived 后缀。Project Atlas archival requires closing Jira tickets, making Confluence pages read-only and preserving Slack history.

title: ATLAS-42 · 归档检查单 / Archive checklist
text: Atlas 归档工单 ATLAS-42：负责人林晨；检查代码仓库、运行手册和知识库链接。关闭遗留高优先级问题后，由项目负责人签署验收。Archive owner: Lin Chen. Close high-priority issues and verify repository and runbook links before sign-off.

title: #atlas · 归档通知 / Archive notice
text: Atlas 归档通知：频道变为只读后仍可搜索历史消息。不要删除包含决策背景的讨论。The archived Atlas channel remains searchable. Preserve decision history; do not delete the channel.

title: Atlas · 发布与回滚 / Release and rollback
text: Atlas 发布：CI 测试通过后创建版本标签，保存构建产物校验和。回滚时部署上一版镜像，数据库变更需要单独的兼容性检查。Release after CI passes; tag the version and record artifact checksums. Roll back to the previous image after checking database compatibility.

title: Atlas · 交接会议 / Handover meeting
text: Atlas 交接会议纪要：林晨负责整理运行手册，周宁接管告警。交接完成标准是接班人独立完成一次故障演练。Lin Chen prepares the runbook; Zhou Ning owns alerts. Handover is complete after an independent incident drill.

title: Atlas · 发布确认邮件 / Release approval
text: Atlas 发布确认：业务验收由产品负责人审批，技术发布由值班工程师执行。审批邮件需要关联发布工单。Business acceptance belongs to the product owner; the on-call engineer executes deployment. Link approval to the release ticket.

title: 新员工 · 入职指南 / Onboarding guide
text: 新员工入职：第一天开启多因素认证，申请最小必需权限，阅读团队运行手册。不要在聊天中发送访问令牌。Onboarding: enable MFA, request least-privilege access and read the team runbook. Never share access tokens in chat.

title: Atlas · 客户交付记录 / Customer handoff
text: Atlas 客户交付：客户成功团队记录验收日期、培训状态和支持联系人。技术缺陷通过 Jira 工单跟踪。Customer success records acceptance, training and support contacts. Track technical defects in Jira.

title: Atlas · 下一轮迭代 / Next iteration
text: Atlas 下一轮迭代优先改善检索延迟和证据展示。尚未承诺发布日期。The next iteration prioritizes retrieval latency and evidence visibility. No release date is committed.
